title: How to Choose the Best Gorgias Plan For You
snippet:
- Gorgias offers five main plans: Starter ($10 USD/month), Basic ($60/month), Pro ($360/month), Advanced ($900/month), and Enterprise (custom quote)

| Starter | $10 USD | 50 | 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Basic | $60 USD | 300 | 500 |
| Pro | $360 USD | 2,000 | 500 |
| Advanced | $900 USD | 5,000 | 500 |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | 500 |

### Free trial
Gorgias offers a free 7-day trial. You can send a maximum of 10 email ticket messages during your trial. You cannot publish a help center during your trial. No credit card is required to start exploring the platform.
Most brands go live within 48 hours using self-serve resources. Gorgias provides setup guides, video tutorials, and email support during your trial.

title: Gorgias pricing plans, tickets and AI Agent fees
snippet:
Gorgias pricing runs from [$10 to $900 a month](https://www.gorgias.com/pricing) on monthly billing, and it’s set by how many tickets you get, not how many people answer them. Starter is $10 a month for 50 tickets, and Advanced is $900 for 5,000, or $750 a month billed yearly. AI Agent is priced on top, by the automated interaction. Each one costs $1.00 within your plan’s allowance on monthly billing, or $0.90 on yearly, and $1.50 past it, and it counts as a ticket as well. There’s no free plan, only a 30-day trial. We read every figure on Gorgias’s [pricing page](https://www.gorgias.com/pricing)

| Plan | Billed monthly | Billed yearly | Tickets a month | Each extra ticket | Seats |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | [$10](https://www.gorgias.com/pricing) | Monthly only | 50 | $0.40 | 3 |
| Basic | [$60](https://www.gorgias.com/pricing) | $50 a month, $600 a year | 300 | $0.40 | 500 |
| Pro | [$360](https://www.gorgias.com/pricing) | $300 a month, $3,600 a year | 2,000 | $0.36 | 500 |
| Advanced | [$900](https://www.gorgias.com/pricing), through sales | $750 a month, $9,000 a year | 5,000 | $0.36 | 500 |
| Custom plan | Priced through sales | Priced through sales | Over 5,000 conversations | Not listed | Not listed |
The plans differ in more than tickets, by the comparison table lower on the same page. Starter gets community support and self-serve onboarding. Basic adds [BigCommerce](https://heydeacon.com/resources/bigcommerce-chatbot) and AI Agent’s brand voice settings and actions, such as cancelling an order or applying a discount. Pro adds Magento, revenue attribution, audit logs and 1:1 onboarding, and Advanced a dedicated customer success manager, an SLA and white-glove onboarding. Every plan’s API allows 2 requests a second, and the custom plan 4.

title: Gorgias pricing (2026): plans, AI fees and what a team pays
snippet:
Gorgias bills by the ticket, never by the person: plans run from Starter at $10 a month for 50 tickets to Advanced at $750 for 5,000 on a yearly contract, and Gorgias AI Agent adds a fee for each conversation it resolves on its own. A team of 5 whose AI resolves 1,000 conversations pays $1,200 or more a month on Pro, 75% of it for the AI.
